title: BitLocker or VeraCrypt: Disk Encryption for Business and Personal Use
excerpt: BitLocker is built into Windows and managed centrally; VeraCrypt is open source and runs on several operating systems. The comparison looks at management, platform support and transparency.
verdict: BitLocker is the right choice for Windows fleets in Active Directory or Intune environments, where keys can be escrowed and policies enforced centrally. VeraCrypt suits individuals and cross-platform users who want open-source, independently audited encryption and can manage their own keys.
